about: Mix-and-match sections for trades & home-service homepages. Every mockup = one base STYLE (tokens: fonts, colours, spacing, buttons) + an ordered set of SECTIONS picked from different source templates. Section crops live in sections/<id>.jpg (built by scripts/crop-sections.py from the measured templates).

styles.fits: hvac airco cooling heating plumbing appliance home service premium calm
hvac airco repair emergency plumbing electrical bold energetic
handyman home repair home service plumbing electrical hvac roofing painting friendly
construction contractor builder renovation roofing concrete industrial bold
construction contractor builder renovation roofing handyman industrial dark

sections.spec: Transparent header over a 900px full-bleed photo with a dark brand-colour overlay; centred pill eyebrow, 64px 2-line headline with tight negative tracking, 24px subline, one button. Along the hero's bottom edge, INSIDE it: a 3-column feature row (80px circle icon + white title + 2 lines).

60px top bar + 100px white header whose right end is a solid brand-colour block (bleeding to the viewport edge) with round phone icon, big phone number and a white pill button. 900px photo hero, text LEFT-aligned: small chip, 80px UPPERCASE 2-line headline, 30px subline, pill button. Two big colour tiles (accent | dark) sit across the hero's bottom edge, half overlapping, each with line icon, 36px title and circled arrow — one per main service line.

Split top bar (accent slanted block left, dark right), white header BOX inset in the container floating over the hero. Photo hero with a centred dark panel whose top-left corner is cut at 45°; inside: brush-stroke accent eyebrow, 64px wide-display headline, subline, square accent button. Diagonal accent stripe shapes in the bottom corners.

Dark top bar with square social cells + dark 100px header, square accent menu button. 800px hero: dark overlay left half with LEFT-aligned text (accent-square eyebrow, 60px UPPERCASE 3-line headline, short 4px accent rule, square button with ↗ arrow), photo on the right half; the business name set vertically as a faint outlined watermark behind the text.

Dark top bar + header where the logo sits on the dark colour and the nav is a white box spanning the rest, accent quote button. 790px hero: accent bracket (⌐ shape) framing a 58px UPPERCASE headline with the last words in the accent colour, button with a pill right end and a circled '+' tab; a large photo on the right. A white radius-10 panel overlaps the hero bottom by ~120px holding heading + phone callout and 3 photo cards with house-shaped accent icon badges and dark caption bars.

Two columns: 576×447 photo (radius 20) left; text column from col 7: pill eyebrow, 42px heading, paragraph, button. Optional full-width row of certification badges (156px) underneath — real ones only.

Masonry left: tall 285×600 photo + stacked 285×180 photo and a dark stat tile (72px number + label). Right: eyebrow, 60px heading, paragraph, a pale quote box (26px/600 quote with a big quote glyph), then a pill button + round founder avatar with name/role.

Overlapping photo collage left (large 470×677 + small 248×265 + a black circular badge with the logo mark and a dashed ring). Right: uppercase eyebrow, 48px heading, paragraph, bold statement with a 2px left rule, two icon+label features at 24px, square button. A diagonal accent stripe runs behind.

Technical-drawing texture background. 590×480 photo left, bleeding past the section's top edge; right: line-before eyebrow, 48px heading, paragraph, square button; a 269px square photo pinned at the bottom-right.

607×576 photo left with a white stat over it; right: eyebrow, two-colour heading (one word in accent), paragraph, one icon feature (80px pale tile + title + text), a 2×2 checklist with accent circle checks, and the button.

Centred heading stack (pill eyebrow, 42px heading, 18px intro). 3 cards (376px, radius 20): photo top 250px with a 70px icon tile overlapping its top-left, 40px body padding, title, text, small button. The three cards use three different fills of one hue: pale, light accent, deep primary.

Heading LEFT + pill button RIGHT on one row. Left half: 2×2 white tiles (padding 45, 1px border, 80px pale icon square, small category label, 24px title); the first tile is solid accent with a small arrow notch at its bottom. Right half: a tall photo with a white text card overlapping its bottom-left.

Dark band with faint topographic line texture and a ruler-tick border at the top. Three services, each a large circular photo (~410px) framed by a thin accent ring offset ~14px, then a 20px wide-display title and centred text.

Pale band. LEFT-aligned heading with a 35px line-before eyebrow and intro. 3 white square-cornered cards: 80px pale icon square, 22px title, one-line text, a 240×140 photo at the bottom, 4px accent bottom rule; square prev/next arrow buttons below.

A dark photo header band (white heading left, round prev/next arrows right) that 3 white cards overlap: photo on top, house-shaped accent badge straddling the photo edge, 22px title, 2 lines, button, and a 14px accent vertical rule down each card's right side.
Pale band, centred heading stack, 3×2 grid of reasons: 64px rounded-square icon (alternating deep/light), title, 3 lines.
Full-height photo on the left half; right: line-before eyebrow, 48px heading, paragraph, then accent 120px square stat blocks with big numbers (real numbers only) and a checklist.
Pale band, centred two-colour heading, a round outlined PLAY button (only if the lead has a video), 3 tab buttons (01. / 02. / 03.) and a tab panel with photo left + text & checklist right.
Large photo on one side bleeding off the page edge; on the other: eyebrow, 60px heading, and 3 stacked reason rows each with a 70px icon, 27px title and text.
Centred heading stack; 4 equal accent-coloured step cards in a row (radius 12, padding 30) each with a small 'Step 1' chip and a title; arrows between cards.

Heading row: big heading left, paragraph right. Then a full-bleed dark photo band split into 4 columns by 1px vertical lines; each column's bottom has a 100px OUTLINED numeral '01'–'04' and a white title.
Dark photo band, centred white heading, 4 steps with 36px accent numbered circles connected by a dashed line, white titles and short text.
4 columns: outline icon with a quarter-circle accent arc behind it, then a 65px number beside a two-line label (small over bold). Real numbers only.
Text left (eyebrow, heading, long paragraph); right: 2×2 masonry of square photos (radius 10) and two stat tiles — one pale with dark number, one deep brand colour with white number.
Heading left + outline pill filter chips right; 3 tall 370×410 project photos with titles.
Dark band, white heading left; project photos in a row, each with a white caption box (30px title) overlapping its bottom edge.
Centred heading with a small accent mark; 3 bordered cards with the photo inside, name uppercase, role, social row. Only with real team photos.
Dark band, centred heading, 4 square photos each with a dark caption bar (role small, name 27px). Only with real team photos.
Centred heading stack; carousel of pale radius-20 cards: 80px round avatar with white ring, accent quote glyph, name, label, centred quote, 5 gold stars, dots below.
Split: photo half + dark half with eyebrow, 60px white heading, big quote, name 27px, stars, arrows.
White: small overline, 40px heading, one large quote (18px) with name/role and rating; photo on the right; slider dots.
Dark photo band; carousel of quote cards with 18px light quote text, round avatar, name.
Pale band, centred heading; rounded photo left (with a small icon tile) + accordion right: 16/600 questions, 1px dividers, chevrons, 20px row padding. Real questions/answers from FACTS only.

Photo left with a giant pale watermark numeral (aria-hidden) and a years-of-experience line (real number only); solid accent form box right (padding 50): 36px title, 60px white inputs (name, phone, service select, message), full-width dark submit.
Dark photo band; heading + contact details on one side, a square-cornered form with dark inputs on the other.
A contact band: big phone callout (red circle phone icon + 'For enquiry' + number) on one side, a short request form or quote CTA on the other, over the brand's dark colour.
Rounded (20px) deep-brand box inside the container: photo fills the left half; right: pill eyebrow ('24/7' only if true) + the phone number at 42px white with a phone icon.
Full-width accent strip, 24px padding: 34px white statement left, phone/quote button right.
Two side-by-side colour tiles (accent | dark) with line icon, 36px title and circled arrow — linking to the two main services or 'call' and 'quote'.
Small centred title, then the partner logo ticker (see PARTNERS rules).
A full-bleed dark strip scrolling UPPERCASE service words separated by accent star glyphs; pair it with the partner-logo ticker if the lead has brand logos.
Brand-colour strip (40px padding) with check icon + 26px statement + button, then a dark footer: logo + about, two link columns, a big 42px phone column; divider and copyright row.
Dark footer, 115px top padding, 4 columns (about, links, services, emergency phone 24px with accent label).
Black footer over a photo texture, 3 columns (contact info, links, newsletter/quote), uppercase wide-display column titles.
Charcoal footer with a texture, 4 columns with 24px/700 titles, a slightly darker bottom bar.
Deep brand-colour footer: a top row with a phone callout and a subscribe/quote box, then 4 columns and a bottom bar.
